queer_characters.name: Megan Bloomfield
queer_characters.notes: Megan is sent to conversion therapy under suspicion of being a lesbian, comes to accept her identity, falls in love with Graham, comes out to her parents, and leaves with her partner in an explicit happy ending.

queer_characters.name: Graham Eaton
queer_characters.notes: Described in the source as openly a lesbian and skeptical of the conversion program; she and Megan fall in love and end the film together.

queer_creators.name: Jamie Babbit
queer_creators.notes: Source states Babbit is a lesbian and has spoken publicly about drawing on her own experiences for the film.

queer_creators.name: Clea DuVall
queer_creators.notes: Source notes DuVall came out publicly as gay in a 2016 op-ed for Advocate.com, years after the film's release.

contributor_notes: Satirical camp comedy about a conversion therapy camp with a non-tragic lesbian romance and explicit happy ending. Both leads are explicitly queer in the text; director Babbit and actor DuVall are publicly out. Source notes the broad camp style sometimes renders the 'ex-gay' camp and side characters (including a counselor storyline) one-dimensionally — a maintainer may wish to evaluate whether this warrants a rep_quality note, but the source doesn't provide enough detail to tag a specific trope. Spicy level estimated as low/mild; not addressed directly in source. No subtitle or audio language info provided.
